projects.name: Crane Clean Energy Center
projects.quote: PJM, the nation’s largest grid operator, selected the Crane Clean Energy Center for expedited grid connection as part of its Reliability Resource Initiative.

projects.name: Nuclear fleet uprate projects
projects.quote: PJM also selected additional uprate projects within our fleet, bringing the total addition to the grid to more than 1,150 megawatts of clean, firm electricity.
